archetype: Jewel & Luxury / Performance Pro (Dark Luxe Automotive)

visual_enhancers.texture: Grain noise overlay on the main body to maintain the dark automotive vibe.

surfaces.cards: Solid flat surface: bg-[#18181f], 1px border border-white/10, no soft shadow. Sharp or rounded-md corners max.
surfaces.dashboard: Technical Grid: border-collapse, subtle borders on right/bottom.
surfaces.buttons: Primary CTA uses #ff3d00. Dark text on primary buttons for contrast.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing between main sections (py-16 to py-24). Tight spacing inside marketplace grids (gap-4 to gap-6).
layout.marketplace_grid: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5. Image-first priority.
layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: The Control Room (dense, max width, strict hierarchy).

components.navigation: Sticky header. Prominent center search bar with category filters. User/Admin icon on right.
components.category_chips: Horizontal scrollable row directly below header. Pill-shaped chips. Active chip takes #ff3d00 background.
components.listing_card: Facebook Marketplace style: Image takes up ~75% of card height. Clean price (large bold), truncated title, and condition/location below. Hover scales image slightly and lightens border.
components.listing_detail: Bento grid structure. Main large image carousel (col-span-full lg:col-span-8). Sticky sidebar (col-span-full lg:col-span-4) for price, key specs, and 'Contact via WhatsApp/Internal Chat' CTAs.
components.admin_dashboard: Admin-only route. Sidebar nav for Listings, Messages, Settings. Tables for inventory. Modals/Drawers for Create/Edit listings with image upload zone.
components.chat_panel: Dual-pane layout. Left: conversation list. Right: active chat thread. Integrated tightly into the dark theme.
components.login_page: Minimalist centered card on dark background with subtle orange glow effect.

motion.hover: Interactive cards -translate-y-1, border brightens. Button bg lightens. Images zoom subtly (scale-105).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure dark text on the orange (#ff3d00) buttons for high contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

images.description: Black sports car for main hero background
Dramatic 370z with tail lights for alternate hero or banner
Detailed car engine for Refacciones category or listing placeholder
Modern metallic car engine part for listing placeholders
Stylish car rims arranged on shelves for Rines category or listing placeholder
Mechanic working in dimly lit garage for contact section background

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve existing aesthetic strictly: #0b0b0d, #131318, #18181f with #ff3d00 accents. Do NOT deviate to a generic light theme.
Use Syne for all display headings and Manrope for body text and numbers.
Ensure all generated frontend code uses .js/.jsx file extensions as per the project requirements, NOT .tsx.
For the marketplace grid, prioritize a high-density, image-first card layout similar to Facebook Marketplace. No bulky paddings around the card content.
For buttons using the primary #ff3d00 background, ensure text contrast by using black or very dark text if white doesn't meet minimum contrast.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Build the dashboard using pure functional Shadcn components with custom styling (dark backgrounds). Admin only needs access.
Implement the categories (Refacciones, Rines, Autos) as sticky chips below the main search navigation.
Apply grain noise overlay across the main background container to preserve the luxe automotive vibe.
